verticals.description: Probes every discovered input for command, SQL, LDAP, XPath, template (SSTI), header/CRLF, and NoSQL injection by submitting a canonical boundary-breaking payload per class and diffing the observed response against a clean baseline. Use when recon has enumerated at least one request-shaped input (form field, query parameter, header, cookie, path segment, or uploaded filename) on any Workspace. Do not use for deserialization of structured payloads (pickle, YAML, XML, Java-object streams) — that's the `deserialization` vertical; this one is for payloads interpreted as code or query syntax, never payloads reconstructed as a data structure.
verticals.name: injection

verticals.description: Enumerates every request-shaped input the Target exposes (form fields, query parameters, headers, cookies, path segments, upload filenames) and attempts to confirm or refute every gate signal a gated vertical declares, recording both to the Workspace's shared surface. Use when a Workspace's Playbook starts, before any other vertical's own investigation begins. Do not use for judging what a discovered input means for a specific weakness class, or for probing it — that's every offensive vertical's own job; this one only maps what the Target exposes and never claims a weakness of its own.
verticals.name: recon
